title: The Institution of the Ma sh riqu’l-A dh kár
textType: Compilation of extracts from the Bahá’í writings
attributionNote: The Institution of the Ma sh riqu’l-A dh kár: the Bahá’í Reference Library's own record of the work, on its Compilations shelf.
description: A Statement and Compilation Prepared by the Research Department of the Universal House of Justice The record was created by the Bahá’í import from the Reference Library's own catalogue and reading views; the summary above is the library's own description of the work, and an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Bahá’í Reference Library, in the section where the Bahá’í International Community publishes the authorised English text (Compilations).
availabilityNote: Complete as the Reference Library publishes it: the library's reading views for this work are streamed from bahai.org at read time, one chapter at a time, with the Community's copyright notice. The chapters are the divisions of the library's own reading text; the publication's front matter and its notes are not imported.
